title: Production SSE Streaming Endpoint
instructions: Implement `create_app` in `stream_gateway.py` (`StreamMetrics` is provided): a `POST /chat/stream` Server-Sent Events endpoint that sends a `meta` event, one data event per token and a `done` event. Failures become in-band `error` events without internals, `: ping` comments keep the connection alive without losing the pending read, `deadline_s` bounds the stream, and the upstream is always closed, including on client disconnect.

evidence.label: Emits meta, token and done events in order with SSE headers and closes the upstream
A mid-stream failure becomes an in-band error event without leaking details
Keep-alive pings are sent while waiting without losing the pending read
The deadline ends the stream with deadline_exceeded and closes the upstream
Time to first token is recorded with the injected clock
A client disconnect cancels the read and closes the upstream
An empty upstream sends done with zero tokens and no TTFT sample
